MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | CI/CD & Platform Engineering
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including hands-on ownership of CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure for three product teams. Built GitLab CI workflows and Helm-based ephemeral environments on a shared Kubernetes cluster; personal projects include a k3s GitOps homelab and Terraform-provisioned Hetzner VPS infrastructure. Seeking to move into a DevOps or platform engineering role.

SKILLS
Infrastructure and delivery: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access at work; k3s in a personal project)
Infrastructure as code and cloud learning: Terraform (personal Hetzner VPS project), Ansible (basic), AWS (personal learning: EC2 and S3 basics)
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki; Grafana dashboards for test metrics
Scripting and data: Python, Bash, SQL, PostgreSQL
Systems and testing: Linux, Git, pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman, Java (test code)

EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021–Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (about 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages, and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage; monthly CI runner cost fell by about 30%.
- Built merge-request ephemeral test environments using Docker Compose and later Helm charts on the company’s shared Kubernetes cluster; environments include the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data and are automatically destroyed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of about 900 tests; reduced the flaky-test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling for PostgreSQL test-data seeding and an internal guide to the CI system used in onboarding.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019–2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated testing.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project and configured Jenkins jobs for nightly runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018–2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024–2025
- Built a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster and deployed applications from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Added Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS; provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform.

Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023–2024
- Implemented short-lived environments for each merge request, deployed via Helm to the shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI, with automatic cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Enabled QA and product teams to review features before merge and run end-to-end tests against the environments.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health | 2022
- Profiled pipelines for three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and split end-to-end tests into a separate stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by about 30%.

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATION AND DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) preparation; exam booked for January 2027 (not yet certified)

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. The opportunity to help shape infrastructure for Corvale Mobility’s new train fleet is a strong match for the direction of my work: building reliable delivery workflows and environments that help teams develop, test and review software with confidence.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and built merge-request environments deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster. These environments bring together the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, run end-to-end tests, and clean themselves up after merge or inactivity. I also reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%. I document how the CI system works for onboarding and work with QA and product teams using the environments.

Alongside my production experience, I built a personal three-node k3s homelab with GitOps deployments, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Traefik and cert-manager, and used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. My production Kubernetes work is at namespace level, with the platform team operating the shared cluster; I have not yet operated a cloud fleet platform. I would bring practical CI/CD and environment automation experience, along with a clear understanding of the scope of my current infrastructure experience.

Corvale’s focus on connecting onboard systems with cloud services makes this role especially interesting: it brings infrastructure, backend services and real-world devices together. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building delivery and test infrastructure could contribute to the fleet connectivity team.

Sincerely,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
